panels.title: Events (Last 60s)
panels.description: Incoming transactions in the last 60 seconds

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 seconds'
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(created_at))), 0)::INT AS value FROM transactions
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM accounts WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM accounts WHERE status = 'frozen'
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS transactions FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Transaction Status Breakdown
panels.description: Completed vs Pending vs Failed vs Flagged

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='completed') AS completed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pending') AS pending, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed') AS failed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='flagged') AS flagged FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Transaction Volume ($)
panels.description: Total completed transaction volume per minute

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(amount)::NUMERIC, 2), 0) AS volume FROM transactions WHERE status='completed' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT txn_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY txn_type
SELECT COALESCE(device_type,'unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY device_type
SELECT CASE WHEN is_international THEN 'International' ELSE 'Domestic' END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY is_international

panels.title: Top Risky Accounts
panels.description: Accounts with highest average risk score

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.account_id, a.full_name, a.account_type, a.status, COUNT(*) AS total_txns, ROUND(AVG(t.risk_score)::NUMERIC, 3) AS avg_risk_score, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status='flagged') AS flagged_txns, ROUND(SUM(t.amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_volume FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE $__timeFilter(t.created_at) GROUP BY t.account_id, a.full_name, a.account_type, a.status ORDER BY avg_risk_score DESC LIMIT 10
